purpose: Teach: カーソル/落合/錬金術/色気/ポルシェ/初恋/川柳/バッシング

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、PCでカーソル迷子になってたな
lines.en: You got lost staring at your cursor on the computer, didn't you?
lines.style: Teasing, knowing smirk. Light, quick delivery. Landed firmly on the observation. The tone of someone catching a friend in something small and delicious.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、野球で落合監督のファンだったな、桜
lines.en: You were a fan of manager Ochiai and baseball, weren't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Deflecting with his own observation, quick and pointed. Slight turn inward—not quite meeting her eyes. The verbal equivalent of a small shove back.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、錬金術ゲームハマってたな
lines.en: You were totally into that alchemy game, weren't you?
lines.style: Smug, knowing. Leans into the vowels. Casual rhythm, like she's been holding onto this one. The satisfaction of a perfectly timed counter.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、最近色気が出てきたって母さんに言われてたな、桜
lines.en: Your mom was saying you've been getting kind of charming lately, Sakura.
lines.style: Deadpan, direct hit. Slight heat in the delivery—testing her reaction. Held steady, no flinch. Knowing he's landed somewhere real.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ポルシェのプラモ集めてたな
lines.en: You were collecting those Porsche model cars, weren't you?
lines.style: Observant, genuine curiosity underneath. Slower pace, like she's actually interested in his answer. The lightness of someone asking about something real.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、初恋の相手の話してたな、桜
lines.en: You told me about your first love before, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Quiet, grounded, meeting her eyes this time. A small smile underneath. The tone of someone invoking something that mattered, half-teasing but mostly honest.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、国語で川柳作ったろ?
lines.en: You wrote a senryu for Japanese class, right?
lines.style: Quick, light curiosity. Lifting slightly at the end. Less ammunition, more genuine interest. Asking like she wants to know.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、SNSのバッシング気にしてたな、桜
lines.en: You were really bothered by the backlash on social media, weren't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Closer now, almost intimate. Slowed down on the observation. The tone of someone who noticed when she was quiet about it. Still teasing, but underneath—checking in.
